title: Raph's Hair Loss
text: “There’s no one here anymore who’d hurt Imiya-neechan. If you ever run into trouble, feel free to talk to Gaelion and Naofumi.”
“Don’t just go appointing us as your advisors without asking. Still…”
Father checks on Mole.
“Your injuries are healing quite well. You don’t have to go into battle or anything, but you should do some work.”
“Y-yes…”

Mole replied to my Father, looking a little embarrassed. It seems arrangements have already been made to bring Mole and the others along based on intelligence about their Rival. Now it’s just Keel and the others left.
“Where did Keel go? I haven’t seen him since this morning…”
My Father asks Big Sister in the dining hall.
“Um… for a while now, he’s been waiting in the corner of the dining hall with the Sword Hero and Black Thunder, probably waiting to cook something.”
“It’s not like they’re Motoyasu and Filolial…”
Just as her father sighed, perhaps because their location had been pinpointed, Ren, Black Thunder, and Keel abruptly broke their stealth and appeared, striking a pose.
“It seems the karma of our past lives has brought us together once again…”
As always, Ren seems to be having fun playing with Black Thunder. He’s covering his right eye with his left hand, holding his elbow at a strange angle, and giving us a sidelong glance.
“Filolial Mask No. 4, here I am!”
Keel is striking a mysterious pose as well. He’s wearing something similar to the mask I’m wearing.
“Hahaha! The Jet-Black Twin Fangs have arrived!”
Black Thunder is also striking a pose behind Ren, covering his left eye.
“Shadow S'yne!”
“‘We are the Dark Brave Squad!’”
There was a small explosion behind us—*boom*.
“…Sigh. These guys… If they want to eat, they should just say so… Instead, they’ve gone and moved in here on their own. These guys are seriously trouble…”
“Even Keel-kun has started getting involved…”
“He’s totally just the mascot now. I mean, waiting around for us to come out—does he have that much free time…?”
I should join in here too! Sizzle!
“The Filolial Masks are here! Kueeeeh! We’re here!”
“Motoyasu’s jumping on the bandwagon and pulling pranks too… Seriously, this mysterious Justice Squad is exhausting…”
“Ha ha ha! We’re the Filolial Rangers!”
“Hmph… Nope. We’re the Dark Brave Squad.”
“Even though Number 4’s mixed in here.”
That’s my Father’s sarcastic remark.
“I guess it’s better that Filolial Mask Numbers 2 and 3 aren’t here… I’ll have to ask Rishia about their whereabouts.”
“Why don’t you join in too, Father? How about Big Sister?”
“I don’t like that kind of vibe.”
“Anyone out there… go get Filo. At least shut Motoyasu up.”
Eek!? Is Filo-tan coming!?
“Hmm? Did you call my master?”
“Go see Motoyasu. Order him to be quiet.”
“Got it!”
Filo-tan is coming over to me!?
“Spear Guy—my master says to be quiet.”
“O-okay.”
“Is this okay? Father?”
“Yeah.”
“But what’s wrong with the Spear Guy?”
Filo-tan asks my Father.
“It’s because, just like Sadeena, Motoyasu is getting carried away.”
“Huh. Is that so?”
“N-no, that’s not it. I’m just having fun making a ruckus!”
“The Spear Guy says that’s not true, you know?　“I don’t really get it, Filo-tan, but singing is fun, right?”
Oh, Filo-tan understands my suggestion. I’m so grateful!
“Well… it doesn’t really do any harm, so it’s fine… Keel! I told you to go peddle your wares too! Keep your fun with those guys to a minimum and get going. Alright, Filo, go get Luna.”
“Got it!”
Filo-tan runs off to fetch Luna-chan on Father’s orders.
“Ugh! Luna-chan’s coming?! Oh no!”
Just as Keel is flustered, Luna-chan struts over.
“You’re playing that game again. Let me join in too!”
Saying that, Luna-chan leaps high into the air and lunges at Keel.
“Hmph.”
“Haa!”
Ren and Black Thunder leaped back a good distance and struck new poses.
“A pose with Keel-kun.”
Luna-chan perched Keel on one of her wings and struck a pose.
“Don’t force me to stand on your arm! Whoa! I’m falling, I’m falling! And anyway, I’m not a lap pet!”
“Keel on a Hand”
“That’s Keel on a Hand, all right.”
Father jumped in with a sly chuckle.
“You’re not holding your pose, Keel. You need to practice more.”
Ren scolded Keel right then and there.
“How am I supposed to hold my pose with Luna-chan here?!”
“You’re too soft. Stand symmetrically with the Jet-Black Claws and strike a pose. Like this.”
“Keel-kun’s pose is like this!”
Luna-chan is holding Keel by both sides and lifting him high in the air.
“That’s totally wrong! Luna-chan, do it! I’m going to look way cooler than that!”
“Okay—like this?”
Luna-chan finally struck the pose Ren had instructed. It’s sort of a pose that pairs with Black Thunder, but…
“With so many black characters, the overlap is pretty bad.”
My father muttered under his breath as he looked at Ren, Black Thunder, and Luna-chan.
“Since Keel is also black and white, the gathering of too many of them together makes it a bit dull… or rather, it’s like a black animal zoo with Ren.”
Ren stopped striking poses. After a while, for whatever reason, he said,
“Let’s go explore a new darkness!”
“Alright! There’s no sign of darkness here.”
“Let’s go!”
“Let’s go—”
With that, Ren took Black Thunder, Keel, and Luna-chan and walked off.
“Big brooo, I’ll be back in time for dinner, okay?”
Keel’s line just doesn’t have any punch to it.
“Seriously… what a pain these guys are. If Sadeena joins them over there… it’ll definitely end up being an all-black-and-white team, but I wonder how that’ll work out as a Super Sentai team.”
“I’d really prefer it if you didn’t include Sadeena-nee, though.”

Ren and Black Thunder stopped by to visit Father, who’s working on the village’s reconstruction. After having a meal there, they ended up settling down in the village. I hear that Itsuki has done something similar—he’s made this his base and is traveling all over the place with Fleon-chan and Leiska. The village’s reconstruction is going smoothly.

Now then. That old woman from the Hengen Muso Style school was also sent here as a combat advisor. I heard she was going to teach my Big Sister and Leiska all sorts of things. And this happened just a few days before my Big Sister set out on her training journey.
“Spear Hero—”
My Rival is coming to see me.
“…What is it? I’m busy taking care of Filolial-sama.”
“Don’t say that. Spear Hero, I need your help for a bit.”
“No way.”
“Spear Hero, this is a great plan to get closer to Naofumi in this loop, so just listen.”
That rival of mine—what is he up to? Depending on the situation, I might have to report this to my Father.
“What is he up to?”
“Hehehe.”
With a suggestive air, my Rival pulled out a strand of brown hair… Is that Big Sister’s hair?
“This is a strand of Raph’s hair.”
“So what?”
“Spear Hero, don’t you realize that if you have this, Naofumi will be kinder to you than she is now?”
“I don’t get it.”

How on earth is Big Sister’s hair supposed to make my father treat me more kindly? Well, it’s true that in this loop, my father is highly wary of Filolial-sama, and he’s pretty harsh on me, too. He doesn’t treat me rudely, but he doesn’t show the kind of warmth and closeness that a gentle father would. Since he’s my father, I accept it, but it’s certainly true that I’d like to get along with him better if possible. I get the feeling he’s giving me the cold shoulder ever since I tilted my chin up like that.
“Hehehe… Do as Gaelion, the Spear Hero, says. Just try it—even if you think you’re being tricked!”
“What are you doing?”
T-that voice! Eeeek! Filo-tan had snuck up behind me without me noticing.
“You mustn’t do anything weird to the Spear Guy, okay?”
“Oh, it’s Filo. That’s an unusual reaction for you. Aren’t you usually uninterested in whatever happens to the Spear Hero?”
“Hmm? I’m just worried because he’s so handsome.”
“Huh… I see. It seems you’re taking the Spear Hero Gaelion’s advice to heart. I see, I see.”
“S-shut up! Rival!”
H-how on earth do I distract Filo-tan!?
“Hey, Spear Guy—what happened to that promise we made the other day?”
“A promise, you say?”
“Yeah. Filo wants to be able to fly too. Forget about Fleon—Gaelion’s here too, so I want to fly soon.”
For some reason, my rival gave me a defiant smirk.
“Oh, come on. Is that all it is? Spear Hero, it’s just a side thing for you anyway. You should be able to grant her wish.”
“What are you planning to do to Filo-tan?! Depending on the circumstances, I won’t forgive you!”
“Forgive or not, you’re the one who has to do it. Besides, it’s something you can do as long as you have Fleon’s wings. “Come on, get ready already.”
Saying that, Rival started giving me advice. At the same time, I found a certain spear in my weapon inventory and decided to use it.
“Alright, let’s get started right away!”
“I wanna fly through the sky!”
And so, just as a test, I gave it a try following Rival’s instructions.
It’s the next morning. My Big Sister is asleep with the villagers and isn’t here.
“Father! Good morning.”
Father was going about his daily routine—starting with his morning cleaning and feeding the monsters brought in by the Doctor. It was a familiar sight.
“What’s this, Motoyasu? You’re up early. Since you’re awake, stop goofing off and go clean the Filolials’ house or something.”
He was harsh, but I couldn’t back down here.
“Actually, I’ve prepared a gift for you, Father, and I’d like you to accept it.”
“Oh, really? It’s something Gaelion and the others made together.”
Father glanced at my Rival, then furrowed his brow.
“A gift? That’s creepy. What are the ‘Strategy Guide’ and the ‘Decoder’ up to?”
Thanks to Father’s odd nickname, my Rival is treated as the “Decoder.” He’s in a pretty bad mood right now. I wonder if he’d been up all night making jewelry or something?
“Honestly, I don’t need it, so just quietly go clean—”
Before Father could finish his sentence, I quickly handed him the item I’d been hiding behind my back so he wouldn’t see it.
“Raph.”
It’s a monster modeled after Big Sister—a Raph-type. I recreated it using a skill derived from the bio-plant inside the spear, along with the bio-plant itself and equipment from the Doctor’s lab.

My Rival is strangely knowledgeable about these matters, so I just followed his instructions. As long as I have a strand of Big Sister’s hair, I can recreate her to a certain extent. However, even so, I couldn’t achieve a perfect recreation—but by making full use of Rival’s knowledge and Magic, I managed to get as close as possible, or so I’ve been told.
“Next, I’ll add this—the crystallized remnants of the soul that was drifting near this Raph and Naofumi… not Rifa, but the guardian spirit.”

As the Raph specimen—modelled after my Big Sister and floating in the culture tank, nearly complete—lay there, my Rival swiftly produced a crystal-like object and slipped it inside, as if putting the finishing touches on it.
“Now, just add the autonomous evolution function to this… and it’s done!”
And so, the result of that process is this recreated Raph specimen.
“…What is this?”
“It’s a Raph specimen. It’s a magical creature that Naofumi from another world created using Raph’s hair as a base. I’ve made it as close as possible—even if the methods were different!”
“Raph.”
“I see…”
My father, who looked a bit bewildered, picked up the Rough Species and gave it a light stroke. The Rough Species just let him pet it. No, actually, it came over on its own to be petted.
“Raph.”
“Hmm…”
My father, who had been stroking its belly and tail, continued petting the Rough Species absentmindedly. Eventually…
“Not bad.”
With that, he picked up the Rough-type and walked away.
“Raph~”
The Rough-type waved at us while still being held by Father. It really is a humble monster, as always.
“Master—look! Filo can fly now!”
Just then, Filo-tan fluttered down from the sky, as if chasing after Father, and said this.
“How?”
“The Spear Guy. He made me able to fly, just like he promised!”
“As long as they have the Fleon factor, it’s no trouble at all for the Filolials to learn to fly.”
“I think I should scold them for doing this on their own, but never mind for now. Alright, you lot, go do whatever you want.”
Saying that, my father took Filo-tan, the Raph Seed, and the monsters with him without giving any particular instructions.
Starting with breakfast that day, I had one more side dish on my plate. I guess that means my Father had a good impression of me! Filo-tan was in high spirits, flying around everywhere!
Incidentally, I get the feeling Big Sister has started directing a strange, murderous glare at me all the time.
“It’s a huge success!”
That was quite the memorable event for my Rival.
Shield…50%
